visual_grammar.label: 3-Pillar 3D Noir Forensic Diorama + 4-Mode Investigative Storytelling
three_pillars: 3D Noir crime-scene and incident architectural scale diorama with single directional volumetric spotlight
100mm forensic macro hardware, black-box switch telemetry, brass gauges, and taut red evidence threads
Atmospheric archival field reconstruction under eerie nocturnal or cold industrial illumination
visual_grammar.anti_repetition_rule: Vary diorama scale, camera framing, and evidence mechanisms across beats; strictly no 2D flat stickmen, no graphic gore, no AI gibberish text (`allowed_text=None` on raw Flow frames), and mandatory bottom-right delogo before watermark overlay.

MODE_1_EVIDENCE_STAMP.role: Bold dark-scrim forensic timestamp, altitude, pressure, or black-box stat callout in #C9A24D / #C0392B

MODE_2_HYPOTHESIS_CONTRAST.role: Side-by-side investigative comparison (competing hypotheses, AUTO vs MAN system states, expectation vs forensic reality)

MODE_3_DOSSIER_CHECKLIST.role: Right-docked #181B22 archival dossier card enumerating up to 3 sequential clues or root causes

MODE_4_NOIR_CINEMATIC_PACING.role: Uncluttered 2K 3D Noir camera progression (2560x1440@30fps, xfade=fade:duration=0.24, plus key-beat omni_flash I2V motion)

visual_style_options.STYLE_1_IMAX_35MM_LIVE_ACTION: Full-scale 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T thriller live-action cinematography (strictly zero miniature/scale-model/wire effects) + clean .ass cinematic subtitles
visual_style_options.STYLE_2_FERN_3D_XRAY_CUTAWAY: Fern / Hoog-style Unreal Engine 5 / Octane 3D technical X-ray cutaway in full flight environment highlighting airflow, valves, and circuit pathways
visual_style_options.STYLE_3_LEMMINO_CHIAROSCURO_ARCHIVE: LEMMiNO-style ultra-minimalist stark chiaroscuro monochrome (#07080C >= 65% negative space) + crimson/silver rim-light & black-box CVR oscilloscope
visual_style_options.STYLE_4_VOX_INVESTIGATIVE_SPLIT_RADAR: Vox / Johnny Harris dark-mode investigative split-screen, 3-panel vertical triptych & live night satellite flight radar reticle
